{{Top|leg}}
'''High-gravity traps''' or '''high grav traps''' were traps used to protect bases and installations.

Typically used in conjunction with other defenses such as [[pit trap]]s and [[walker barrier]]s, High-gravity traps functioned on the same principle as [[Reversed repulsorfield|man traps]], but on a much larger scale: consisting of gravity generators buried underground, High-gravity traps were powerful enough not only to immobilize numerous troops, but also to immobilize [[Speeder/Legends|speeders]] and other small [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] vehicles.
